subject: Stat Testing Directly on bar charts

messages.author: 53876b6270ad9337
messages.subject: Stat Testing Directly on bar charts
parts:
Good Afternoon Group,

I'm wondering if anyone has seen a method for showing tests of significance automatically on top of a barplot. It's quite a frequent task for me to present bar graphs that have lettered identifications of statistical significance between classes of categorical or nominal variables. Usually I'll plot the graph and then add the stat testing to the plot with text boxes in PowerPoint. I'm wondering if there's a way to do so within ggplot.

TIA,

Brandon Erik Bertelsen
bra...@bertelsen.ca
Linkedin
